title: Model-variant evolution playbook and customer experimental lifecycle
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Goal: Create a playbook that treats model-variant changes as a first-class product lifecycle with an explicit experimental stage for customers. This ticket covers launch planning, release notes coordination, SDK and Console warnings, migration guides, telemetry gating, and cross-team GTM tasks for evolving or sunsetting model variants tied to the inference gateway. The playbook should enable safe canarying to a small percentage of traffic, offer clear migration artifacts for customers (prompts, examples, compatibility matrix), and a comms cascade that spans: in-console banners, email cohorts, SDK deprecation warnings, release notes, and support runbook templates. Outcome: a repeatable checklist, templated comms, release-note artifacts, tracked telemetry signals and an ops rollback plan.
acceptance_criteria: Playbook doc published in Confluence with step-by-step checklist and owners
Customer-facing migration guide published with code examples for JS/Python SDKs
Release notes and in-console banner templates approved by legal and comms
Canary rollout plan defined and validated with perf/quality gates in the staging environment
Telemetry dashboards (latency, cost per token, quality regressions) live and alerted
rollout_timeline: 2025-02-10: Finalize compatibility matrix and test vectors
2025-02-17: Publish internal playbook and run a dry-run with Platform/Support
2025-02-24: Begin 5% canary for non-SLA customers, monitor 72h
2025-03-03: Expand to 25% if gates pass, start targeted comms to affected customers
2025-03-10: Full rollout and GA release notes, schedule post-launch review
comms_timeline: T-minus 21 days: Notify partner and enterprise customers via account teams (template provided)
T-minus 14 days: Publish detailed migration guide + sample prompts in Docs
T-minus 7 days: Console banner (read-only) + SDK deprecation warning in beta channel
Day 0 (canary start): Release notes posted and dedicated Slack channel for live issues
Post GA + 2 weeks: Customer webinar + office hours and aggregated FAQ
playbook_steps: Inventory dependent routes and SDK surface area; generate compatibility matrix
Assemble test vectors and baseline evaluation set (PM + Applied ML)
Define objective gates: latency increase < 10ms p95, no >5% drop in eval score, no increase in error rate
Prepare migration artifacts: code snippets, recommended param mappings, fallback policy examples
Coordinate with Console to schedule in-app messaging and rollout toggles
Create staged release notes: internal summary, public summary, engineering changelog
Set up telemetry dashboards and automated alerts; instrument SDK warning metrics
Run a cross-functional dry-run (Platform, Support, SRE, Legal, Comms), collect feedback
Execute canary and gate checks, iterate, and either promote or roll back according to playbook
